meta.title: Market conventions — single source of truth
meta.description: Canonical per-product market conventions. All code (C++ reference builders, the Python web compiler and seed) MUST pull from here rather than hardcoding conventions inline. New instruments add an entry here first. Cross-checked against OpenGamma Strata (codified conventions), CME (SOFR OIS + SR1/SR3 futures + EUR/USD xccy), ISDA/ARRC (RFR + interdealer xccy), Fed/ECB (SOFR/ESTR). Ambiguities resolved with the desk 2026-07.
sources: CME SOFR futures contract specifications; EUR/USD xccy basis futures
ISDA RFR Conventions and IBOR Fallbacks Product Table (Oct 2021); ISDA notional/tenor survey (2021)
ARRC interdealer cross-currency swap recommendations; Clarus RFR xccy mechanics
31 CFR Part 356 Appendix B (US Treasury auction price/yield formulas); Rateslib bond calc-mode table (us_gb / us_gb_tsy); QuantLib Compounding::{Compounded,SimpleThenCompounded}
notes: Business-day convention is ModifiedFollowing throughout unless stated.
'spot_lag' / 'payment_lag' / 'fixing_lag' are in BUSINESS DAYS on the stated calendar.
Convexity for futures is NOT a convention: it is a per-quote user input added to the quote before calibration (desk decision 2026-07).

USD overnight calendars are split (desk 2026-07): SOFR fixes on the SOFR/SIFMA calendar (USD-SOFR, closes Good Friday), EFFR/Fed Funds on the Federal Reserve calendar (USD-FED). The EUR/USD FX & xccy joint calendar uses the SIFMA government-bond calendar (USD) on the USD side.

bonds: only conventions the engine supports END TO END (builder + QuantLib oracle) are listed. UK gilts, French OATs and Bunds are ONE entry away -- the kernel already reproduces their yield math exactly (verified against Rateslib uk_gb/fr_gb to 12 digits) -- but gilts need ex-dividend handling and a GBP calendar, and Bunds a EUR bond calendar, so they are deliberately NOT listed yet rather than listed half-supported. BTPs additionally need a payment-date adjustment.

calendars.holidays: rule-based holiday DATA interpreted by include/swaps/build/calendar.hpp (codegen'd via gen_conventions_hpp.py). Rule kinds: fixed {month, day, from_year?}, nth_weekday {month, weekday, n}, last_weekday {month, weekday}, easter_offset {days} (Good Friday = -2, Easter Monday = +1, Gregorian computus). weekday is Python-style Mon=0..Sun=6; 'weekend' lists the weekend weekdays. 'observance' shifts a rule's date off the weekend: 'sat_to_fri_sun_to_mon' (US bond market: Sat -> preceding Fri, Sun -> following Mon), 'sun_to_mon' (Federal Reserve: Sun -> Mon only, Sat NOT observed), 'none' (TARGET; also every nth/last-weekday and easter rule -- they never need shifting). Per-calendar 'observance' is the default; a rule-level 'observance' overrides it. NOTE (transcribed legacy behavior, kept bit-for-bit): a year's holiday set is generated FROM that year's rules, so a New Year observed on Dec-31 lands in the PREVIOUS year's dates but the NEXT year's bucket -- business-day lookup buckets by the queried date's own year, so such a spilled observance is inert (e.g. 2021-12-31 is a USD business day even though Jan-1-2022 fell on a Saturday). Joint calendars ('join') carry no rules: closed if ANY leg is closed.

2026-09-09: currencies (repo_day_count), credit.cds_products, bond_futures, fx_pairs and cb_schedules sections added — the values these replaced were C++ literals (recovery 0.40, quarterly, 365/360; CF 6% / 3-month rounding / repo ACT/360; USD pivot; web-side BAKED meeting table). NZD/SEK/NOK meeting dates from the web table are NOT carried until those currencies exist in the DB.

USD-SOFR-OIS.description: USD fixed vs SOFR OIS. >1Y annual; <=1Y single period.

USD-FEDFUNDS-OIS.description: USD fixed vs Fed Funds OIS. Fed Funds OIS COMPOUNDS the overnight fixings (the averaged variant is a separate product, same fixings).

USD-FF-SOFR-BASIS.description: USD Fed Funds / SOFR basis: EFFR + spread vs SOFR flat, both overnight, SOFR-discounted. The FF leg is the H.15 ARITHMETIC AVERAGE of the daily fixings (compounding: averaged) — that is the market convention for the basis leg, and it is what distinguishes this product from USD-FEDFUNDS-OIS, which COMPOUNDS the very same fixings (ISDA OIS-COMPOUND). Spread on the FF leg.

EUR-ESTR-OIS.description: EUR fixed vs ESTR OIS. Payment lag 2 BD (desk-confirmed; EONIA legacy was 1 BD).

EUR-EURIBOR-3M-IRS.description: EUR vanilla fixed vs EURIBOR-3M. Fixed leg 30E/360 annual (Eurobond basis); float EURIBOR-3M Act/360 quarterly.

EUR-EURIBOR-6M-IRS.description: EUR vanilla fixed vs EURIBOR-6M. Fixed leg 30E/360 annual (Eurobond basis); float EURIBOR-6M Act/360 semiannual.

JPY-TONA-OIS.description: JPY fixed vs TONA OIS. Tokyo calendar; ACT/365F both legs, annual (>1Y; single period <=1Y), compounded. ISDA/JSDA RFR standard (post-JPY-LIBOR).

GBP-SONIA-OIS.description: GBP fixed vs SONIA OIS. London calendar; ACT/365F both legs, annual, compounded. Spot lag 0 (GBP OIS trades T+0) and no payment delay per market standard (post-GBP-LIBOR).

AUD-AONIA-OIS.description: AUD fixed vs AONIA (RBA interbank overnight cash rate) OIS. Sydney calendar; ACT/365F both legs, annual, compounded. Spot T+1.

AUD-BBSW-3M-IRS.description: AUD vanilla fixed vs BBSW-3M. Sydney calendar; both legs quarterly ACT/365F (market standard for shorter tenors). Spot T+1. BBSW is NOT discontinued.

AUD-BBSW-6M-IRS.description: AUD vanilla fixed vs BBSW-6M. Sydney calendar; both legs semiannual ACT/365F (market standard for longer tenors). Spot T+1.

CAD-CORRA-OIS.description: CAD fixed vs CORRA OIS. Toronto calendar; ACT/365F both legs, annual, compounded. Spot T+1; payment 1 Toronto business day after the period end (CARR; LCH conversion consultation 2023). CORRA-first standard (CDOR ceased Jun 2024).

CHF-SARON-OIS.description: CHF fixed vs SARON OIS. Zurich calendar; ACT/360 both legs, annual, compounded. Spot T+2 (post-CHF-LIBOR).

CNY-FR007-IRS.description: CNY 7-day repo (FR007) IRS. Beijing/CFETS calendar; both legs quarterly ACT/365F, floating leg compounds the weekly FR007 fixings within each quarter. Spot T+1. Most-traded CNY interest-rate swap.

CNY-SHIBOR-3M-IRS.description: CNY fixed vs 3M SHIBOR IRS. Beijing/CFETS calendar; fixed leg quarterly ACT/365F, float SHIBOR-3M quarterly ACT/360. Spot T+1.

INR-MIBOR-OIS.description: INR fixed vs overnight MIBOR (FBIL) OIS. Mumbai calendar; ACT/365F both legs, compounded, annual (>1Y) / single-period (<=1Y). Spot T+1. (MIFOR — USD-forward-implied — is a separate rate, not modelled here.)

BRL-CDI-SWAP.description: BRL DI x Pre swap (fixed vs CDI), B3/ANBIMA calendar, BUS/252 both legs, Following. ZERO-COUPON: the CDI leg compounds daily to maturity and the fixed leg pays (1+r)^tau - 1 at maturity, one settlement; r is the annually-compounded (exponential, BUS/252) DI rate = QuoteKind ZeroCouponRate. CDI ~ SELIC overnight. Spot T+0: registered and started on the trade date, whose CDI accrues (B3 swap manual).

MXN-TIIE-28-IRS.description: MXN fixed vs TIIE-28D IRS. Mexico City calendar; both legs every 28 days (13 periods/yr) ACT/360, compounding none. Spot T+1. The standard Mexican swap.

MXN-FTIIE-OIS.description: MXN fixed vs F-TIIE (TIIE de Fondeo, Banxico overnight RFR) OIS. Mexico City calendar; ACT/360 both legs, annual, compounded. Spot T+2 (LatAm SEF certification 2024; DTCC trades). New RFR replacing TIIE-28.

KRW-KOFR-OIS.description: KRW fixed vs KOFR (Korea Overnight Financing Repo Rate) OIS. Seoul calendar; ACT/365F both legs, annual, compounded. Spot T+1. New RFR (legacy CD-91 IRS still trades).

ZAR-ZARONIA-OIS.description: ZAR fixed vs ZARONIA OIS. Johannesburg calendar; ACT/365F both legs, annual, compounded. Spot T+0. New RFR (SARB, live 2023; JIBAR transition underway).

ZAR-JIBAR-3M-IRS.description: ZAR fixed vs 3M JIBAR IRS. Johannesburg calendar; both legs quarterly ACT/365F. Spot T+0. Standard ZAR swap (JIBAR still primary).

TRY-TLREF-OIS.description: TRY fixed vs TLREF (Turkish Lira Overnight Reference Rate) OIS. Istanbul calendar; ACT/360 both legs, annual, compounded. Spot T+1.

IDR-INDONIA-OIS.description: IDR fixed vs IndONIA (Indonesia Overnight Index Average) OIS. Jakarta calendar; ACT/360 both legs, annual, compounded. Spot T+2.

RUB-RUONIA-OIS.description: RUB fixed vs RUONIA (Ruble Overnight Index Average) OIS. Moscow calendar; ACT/365F both legs, annual, compounded. Spot T+1. NOTE: RUB largely non-deliverable post-2022 sanctions; included for completeness.

SAR-SAIBOR-3M-IRS.description: SAR fixed vs 3M SAIBOR IRS. Riyadh calendar (Fri/Sat weekend); fixed leg semiannual ACT/360, float SAIBOR-3M quarterly ACT/360. Spot T+2.

ARS-BADLAR-IRS.description: ARS fixed vs BADLAR (private-bank 30-35d large-deposit rate) IRS. Buenos Aires calendar; both legs monthly ACT/360. Spot T+2. NOTE: ARS heavily capital-controlled / non-deliverable offshore.

EUR-3S6S-BASIS.description: EUR 3s6s tenor basis: EURIBOR-3M + spread vs EURIBOR-6M flat. Spread on the SHORTER (3M) leg. ESTR-discounted.

USD-SOFR-1M-FUTURE.description: CME SR1: 100 - arithmetic AVERAGE of daily SOFR over the calendar month. Act/360. Convexity is a user input on the quote.

USD-SOFR-3M-FUTURE.description: CME SR3: 100 - COMPOUNDED SOFR over the IMM quarter. Act/360. Convexity is a user input on the quote.

USD-FEDFUNDS-1M-FUTURE.description: CME FF 1M: 100 - arithmetic AVERAGE of daily Fed Funds over the calendar month. Act/360. Convexity is a user input.

FX-FWD-EURUSD.description: EUR/USD FX forward outright = spot * DF_EUR(T) / DF_USD(T). Spot T+2 on the joint calendar.

XCCY-MTM-EURUSD.description: EUR/USD mark-to-market cross-currency basis (RFR vs RFR). USD SOFR leg is FLAT and RESETTABLE (notional resets to FX spot); EUR ESTR leg carries the basis spread and has constant notional (EUR is the base). Quarterly, 2 BD lag on coupons/resets/notional exchanges.

USD-PRIME.description: US Prime — a bank-administered reference rate, generally set but occasionally movable. Modelled as a user-remarkable basis (a spread curve, e.g. over Fed Funds) that users may re-mark periodically. NOT a hard market-calibrated instrument.

US-TREASURY.description: US Treasury note/bond quoted on the STREET convention: semiannual ACT/ACT ICMA, yield compounded at f=2, with the fractional first period discounted COMPOUND -- except once settlement reaches the final coupon period, where the market discounts the remaining stub SIMPLE (~0.7 bp difference). Matches QuantLib Compounded (and SimpleThenCompounded in that final period) and Rateslib 'us_gb'.

US-TREASURY-TSY.description: The SAME instrument quoted on the TREASURY METHOD -- 31 CFR Part 356 Appendix B, which is also what Bloomberg reports as the Treasury (as opposed to street) yield. Identical cashflows and accrued; the fractional first period is discounted SIMPLE always, not only in the final period. Every App B Section II sub-case is written 'P[1 + (r/s)(i/2)] = ...'. Matches QuantLib SimpleThenCompounded and Rateslib 'ust_31bii' / 'us_gb_tsy'. This is the convention App B's worked examples (new issues and reopenings) are written for, so it is the natural pairing for when-issued quotes.

CME-TU.description: CME 2-Year T-Note future: 1y9m–2y remaining, rounding to whole months

CME-FV.description: CME 5-Year T-Note future: 4y2m–5y3m remaining, rounding to whole months

CME-TY.description: CME 10-Year T-Note future: 6.5–10y remaining, rounding to whole quarters

CME-US.description: CME classic T-Bond future: 15–25y remaining, rounding to whole quarters

CDS-USD-SNAC.description: ISDA Standard North American Contract: quarterly IMM (20th) premium, ACT/360, T+1 settlement, senior recovery 40%.

CDS-EUR-STEC.description: ISDA Standard European Contract: quarterly IMM premium, ACT/360, T+1, senior recovery 40%.

EURUSD.description: EUR/USD: EUR base, USD quote; spot T+2 on the joint calendar; premium in USD; spot-delta, delta-neutral ATM (interbank major).

USD-SOFR.source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York markets API, rates/secured/sofr (SOFR first published 2018-04-03)

USD-FEDFUNDS.source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York markets API, rates/unsecured/effr (current EFFR methodology from 2016-03-01)

EUR-ESTR.source: ECB Data Portal, EST dataflow (euro short-term rate, first published 2019-10-02)

EUR-EURIBOR-3M.source: ECB Data Portal, FM dataflow: 3-month EURIBOR, monthly average (historical close)

EUR-EURIBOR-6M.source: ECB Data Portal, FM dataflow: 6-month EURIBOR, monthly average (historical close)

US-CPI-U.label: US CPI-U NSA (all urban consumers, BLS CPURNSA)
US-CPI-U.source: USD zero-coupon inflation swap convention: CPI-U NSA with a 3-month lag and daily linear interpolation between monthly prints (the TIPS index-ratio method)

UK-RPI.label: UK RPI NSA (ONS)
UK-RPI.source: GBP zero-coupon inflation swap convention: RPI with a 2-month lag, no interpolation (monthly step)

EU-HICPXT.label: Eurozone HICP ex tobacco NSA (Eurostat)
EU-HICPXT.source: EUR zero-coupon inflation swap convention: HICPxT with a 3-month lag, no interpolation

FR-CPIXT.label: France CPI ex tobacco NSA (INSEE)
FR-CPIXT.source: French inflation swap convention: CPI ex tobacco with a 3-month lag, no interpolation (OATi/OATei bonds interpolate daily instead)
